pondKeyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 photorealistic photo of a traditional earthen shrimp pond (vuong tom) in the Mekong Delta of southern Vietnam, at golden hour. Seen from the pond bank at a slightly high angle. In the center, two tanned hands hold the bamboo frame of a square lift net that is lowered just under the calm brown-green water surface. Background: the pond bank with nipa palms and mangrove trees, softly blurred. Warm golden sunlight from the left. Keep the net and hands inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No face visible. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same camera, the same pond, the same trees and the same warm light. The two hands have now lifted the square net up out of the water: the net is full of many live tiger prawns, grey-blue with dark stripes, wet and glistening, some jumping, water dripping from the net back into the pond. No text, no watermark.
